buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic Actual delivery (and Installation & Commissioning (if covered in scope of supply)) is to be done at following address Department of Electronics & Electrical Communication Engineering Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur Kharagpur Dist- West Medinipur West Bengal-721302 . 2. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 3. Generic Bidders shall quote only those products (Part of Service delivery) in the bid which are not obsolete in the market and has at least 7 years residual market life i.e. the offered product shall not be declared end-of- life by the OEM before this period. 4. Generic Buyer Organization specific Integrity Pact shall have to be complied by all bidders. Bidders shall have to upload scanned copy of signed integrity pact as per Buyer organizations policy along with bid. Click here to view the file 5. Generic Data Sheet of the product(s) offered in the bid, are to be uploaded along with the bid documents. Buyers can match and verify the Data Sheet with the product specifications offered. In case of any unexplained mismatch of technical parameters, the bid is liable for rejection.

6. Generic End User Certificate: Wherever Bidders are insisting for End User Certificate from the Buyer, same shall be provided in Buyer’s standard format only. 7. Generic Experience Criteria: The Bidder or its OEM {themselves or through reseller(s)} should have regularly, manufactured and supplied same or similar Category Products to any Central / State Govt Organization / PSU for 3 years before the bid opening date. Copies of relevant contracts to be submitted along with bid in support of having supplied some quantity during each of the year. In case of bunch bids, the primary product having highest value should meet this criterion. 8. Generic Manufacturer Authorization:Wherever Authorised Distributors/service providers are submitting the bid, Authorisation Form /Certificate with OEM/Original Service Provider details such as name, designation, address, e-mail Id and Phone No. required to be furnished along with the bid 9. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Supply Installation Testing Commissioning of Goods and Training of operators and providing Statutory Clearances required (if any) 10. Turnover Bidder Turn Over Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the bidder during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document. Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the bidder is less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria. 11. Turnover OEM Turn Over Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the OEM of the offered product during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document. Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the OEM is less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria. In case of bunch bids, the OEM of CATEGORY RELATED TO primary product having highest bid value should meet this criterion. 12. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 13. Service & Support Escalation Matrix For Service Support : Bidder/OEM must provide Escalation Matrix of Telephone Numbers for Service Support. 14. Warranty Warranty period of the supplied products shall be as given in specifications from the date of final acceptance of goods or after completion of installation, commissioning & testing of goods (if included in the scope of supply), at consignee location. OEM Warranty certificates must be submitted by Successful Bidder at the time of delivery of Goods. The seller should guarantee the rectification of goods in case of any break down during the guarantee period. Seller should have well established Installation, Commissioning, Training, Troubleshooting and Maintenance Service group in INDIA for attending the after

sales service. Details of Service Centres near consignee destinations are to be uploaded along with the bid. 15. Certificates ISO 9001: The bidder or the OEM of the offered products must have ISO 9001 certification. 16. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 17. Certificates The bidder is required to upload, along with the bid, all relevant certificates such as BIS licence, type test certificate, approval certificates and other certificates as prescribed in the Product Specification given in the bid document. 18. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Bidder should be manufacturer (OEM)/ Authorised dealer. Valid letter of Authorisation (Bid Specific) f rom original equipment manufacturer (OEM) should be enclosed in case of authorised dealer partici pating in the tender. 2. Bidder should provide bid-specific OEM authorization to ensure their support for this work. 3. All efforts shall be made by the bidders to provide the items in consonance with the Make in India P olicy of the Government of India as per the latest notification of the Government of India. Wherever Make in India products are available, the same shall be quoted for supply and installation. Preference shall be given to the bidders who quote maximum Make in India items. 4. Manufacturer should have valid PAN & GST Registration Certificate. 5. If an authorized agent submits bid on behalf of the Principal/OEM, the same authorized agent shall n ot submit a bid on behalf of another Principal/OEM in the same tender for the same item/product. 6. Certified financial statement of the bidder from a Chartered Accountant, such as the Balance Sheet and Profit & Loss Account of the last 3 financial years, clearly indicating the average turnover in the supply and installation of similar types of items. The average financial turnover of bidders must not b e less than 50% of the order value during last 3 FYs. 7. OEM should have minimum average turnover of 4x times the order value, during last 3 Financial Years (FY), certified by a Chartered Accountant (CA). 8. 5-years OEM warranty, 24 X7 support with NBD Response. Warranty of the product should be reflec ted / verified un the support webpage of the OEM (trackable by service tag / system serial.) 9. Escalation Matrix for Service Support: Both the Bidder and OEM must provide Escalation Matrix of T elephone Numbers for Service Support. 10. The OEM service centre(s) must have been operational in West Bengal at least six months prior to t he tender publication date. The reference documents should be submitted, (GST Registration/Trade Licensee/ Rent agreement as evidence.) 11. OEM/Bidder must have ISO 9001, 14001, 27001, Energy Star, EPEAT Silver India certifications. 12. All Product offered should include delivery, Installation and testing along with all required accessori es. 13. Compliance has to be provided on the OEM letterhead, or else the bid may be rejected. 14. Non-compliance of tender terms, non-uploading of required documents, lack of clarity of the specific ations, contradiction between bidder specifications and supporting literature etc. may lead to rejecti on to the bid.

15. The Equipment offered by the OEM or equipment of the same series/family from the same OEM sho uld have been satisfactory working in Government/PSUs/Telecom Service Providers network for at le ast 12 months as on opening of bid in India. 16. Consignee Location- IIT Kharagpur, West Bengal 17. The Technical Compliance and Warranty undertaking should be submitted on the OEM letterhead. 18.Earnest Money Deposit (EMD): An amount of Rs. 5,80,000.00 (Rupees Five Lakh Eighty thousand on ly) (refundable) in the form of Demand Draft (DD)/ Fixed Deposit Receipt (FDR)/ Banker’s Cheque (BC) pai d in favour of “INDIAN INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY KHARAGPUR”, payable at Kharagpur must be submitte d with the bid. Any bid without EMD will summarily be rejected. No interest is payable on EMD. EMD will be refunded to the unsuccessful bidder after finalization of the bidding process stage by stage i.e. Technical e valuation and Financial evaluation. The EMD of the vendor awarded the contract may be treated as part of security deposit towards Performance Guarantee. EMD shall be forfeited if the selected vendor after award of the contract fails to execute the same. Bidders has to upload scanned copy/proof of the Demand Draft (DD)/ Fixed Deposit Receipt (FDR)/ Banker’ s Cheque (BC)aIong with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the buyer at below mentioned addr ess within 5 days of Bid End date/Bid Opening date. To The Assistant Registrar Stores and Purchase Section Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur Kharagpur – 721302. 19.Payment Terms: i. 90% payment of the total contract shall be made after receipt of stores in good order a nd condition, successful installation and demonstration, thereafter certification of your bill by the concerned Head of the Department/ Centers/Schools/Units. ii. Balance 10% payment of the contract value may be released against submission of Per formance Security to the tune of 3% of the total Contract Value or on completion of war ranty period. 20. Performance Security: Performance Security may be submitted in the form of Demand Draft/ Fixed Deposit Receipt/ Performance Bank Guarantee (PBG) from any of the commercial banks in India and paid i n favour of “INDIAN INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY KHARAGPUR”, payable at Kharagpur to the tune of 3% of the total contract value. The PBG shall be valid for the period of warranty period plus 60 days. The p erformance security will be forfeited and credited to the procuring Entity’s account in the event of breach of contract by the contractor. The address for submission of hard copy of the Security Deposit is as follows : To The Assistant Registrar Stores and Purchase Section Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur Kharagpur – 721302. 21. Jurisdiction: All questions, disputes, or differences arising under, out of or in connection with the con tract, if concluded, shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction at the place from which the acceptance of

Tender is issued i.e. Jurisdiction of KOLKATA HIGH COURT. Acceptance to this effect is also necessary at th e time of opening of Technical Bid. Important Note: Bidders should submit the following certificates as per Annexures 1. Declaration of Local Content as per Annexure-I 2. Certificate for Land Border Sharing as per Annexure –II; and 3. Undertaking regarding Blacklisting/Non-debarment as per Annexure-III The above-mentioned Annexures are available through Google through Google Link: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1DvPQWyOO_81KxfObLiWqaVtCyeSASWzp/view?usp=sharing 22. Integrity Pact: All Bidders shall have to sign the Integrity Pact with the Institute as per attached format. Bids without a signed Integrity Pact shall be rejected. This Tenders comes under the purview of the Integrity Pact as per stipulations issued by the Governme nt from time to time. Also, the Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) issued by Central Vigilance Commis sion (CVC) vide Circular No.: 05/01/22 dated: 25.01.2022 shall be adhered to while implementing the In tegrity Pact in the tenders. Therefore, it is mandatory for prospective bidders to sign the Integrity Pact against the tender as per format. The IP would be implemented through a panel of Independent Externa l Monitors (IEMs).
